headline: Rescuers scramble to find Venezuela earthquake survivors. And, SCOTUS rules on asylum
context: Rescuers are searching for thousands of people missing after two earthquakes struck Venezuela on Wednesday. And, the Supreme Court says the U.S. can turn away asylum seekers at the border.
